keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «핀이 주문을 잘못 외웠다(실수)» 와 «핀은 마법을 조심해서 써야 한다는 것을 배운다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the mistake (Finn says the wrong word) and the lesson (Finn learns to be careful with magic). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Finn says the wrong word, and his teacher turns into a frog.
Finn learns to be careful with magic.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does the teacher turn into a frog?
evs: Finn is a young wizard in training.
Oops! He says the wrong word.
Finn opens his spell book and reads very carefully.
why: 핀이 주문을 잘못 외워서 선생님이 개구리가 돼요.
Finn says the wrong word, so his teacher turns into a frog.

qs.q: "Finn is a young wizard in training." What does "in training" mean?
evs: Now his teacher is a big green frog!
Oops! He says the wrong word.
why: 핀에게는 마법을 가르치는 선생님이 있어요. «in training» 은 아직 배우는 중이라는 뜻이에요.
Finn has a teacher. "In training" means he is still learning.

qs.q: How does Finn fix his mistake?
opts: He reads his spell book carefully and says a new spell.
He asks a prince for help.
He runs away from the school.
evs: Finn opens his spell book and reads very carefully.
Today, he must turn a frog into a prince.
Now his teacher is a big green frog!
why: 핀이 주문책을 꼼꼼히 읽고, 새 주문 «Abra-ca-DONE!» 을 외워요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Finn reads his spell book carefully, and then he says "Abra-ca-DONE!" You need both sentences.

ends: Finn tries again and turns the frog into a prince.
핀이 다시 도전해서 개구리를 왕자로 바꾼다.
Finn's teacher teaches the class a fun flying spell.
선생님이 반 아이들에게 재미있는 하늘 나는 주문을 가르쳐 준다.

write.src: “Let’s <u>read the spell book</u> before <u>we do magic</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what to do together and what happens later in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 써 보세요. (예: before Dad comes home)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write who + what. (e.g. before Dad comes home)

img.cover: In a stone classroom with shelves of glass potion bottles, Finn, a young boy with messy red hair, freckles, a blue robe with yellow stars and a short wooden wand, covers his mouth in shock as purple sparkles swirl around a big green frog wearing round glasses and a purple pointy hat on the teacher's chair, while a small frog on the desk watches.

scenes.1: On a wooden desk in a stone classroom, a big green frog wearing round glasses and a purple pointy hat stands up and points a webbed finger at Finn, a young boy with messy red hair, freckles, a blue robe with yellow stars and a short wooden wand, who looks worried and scratches his head.
scenes.2: In the stone classroom, Finn, a young boy with messy red hair, freckles, a blue robe with yellow stars and a short wooden wand, holds open a big old spell book and waves his wand, and golden sparkles turn the frog back into his teacher, a tall woman with a long white braid, round glasses and a purple pointy hat, who smiles at him.

alt.1: The frog teacher points at worried Finn.
alt.2: Finn reads his spell book and turns the teacher back.
alt.cover: Finn's spell turns his teacher into a big green frog.
